A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FALCON research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–I support reliable comparison, including matching content moved between sections.

before.justification: V1 reports original CALVIN, SimplerEnv, and real-world robot experiments, together with depth-estimation results and component ablations.

after.justification: V2 retains those empirical results and adds CALVIN modality-transfer controls and parameter-sensitivity experiments.

M1.justification: The ESM, optional geometric conditioning, additive action-head fusion, action predictors, and two-stage training procedure remain unchanged. The training loss moves from Appendix A into Section 3.3; newly disclosed hyperparameter values do not establish an altered method.

E1.justification: The datasets, manipulation tasks, real-world variations, and evaluated RGB/RGB-D input types remain unchanged. The added CALVIN experiments vary training–testing modality combinations and model settings within this retained coverage.

E2.justification: V2 Table 5 adds RGB-only Kosmos-VLA without ESM to the modality comparison; v1 Table 4 included only its RGB-D point-cloud variant. Comparator membership in the headline simulation and real-world evaluations remains unchanged.

E3.justification: V2 adds tests that hold training modality fixed while adding or removing depth at inference. Appendix E additionally tests loss weights 0.01/0.05 and Kosmos-VLA LSTM configurations (H,C)=(16,10),(16,5),(8,10). These are additional experimental settings, not revisions to FALCON's headline evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The diagnostic scope expands substantially through controlled test-time depth addition/removal, loss-weight sensitivity, and LSTM history/chunk-length studies with convergence curves (Table 5 and Appendix E). Existing injection-position, fusion, and wrist-camera analyses are retained; the first two move into Section 4.3.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training-seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. V2's added loss curves depict optimization trajectories rather than uncertainty across runs.

E6.justification: Headline and real-world results remain unchanged. Added CALVIN results include RGB-only Kosmos-VLA averages of 4.01/3.48, depth-switching results, loss-weight averages of 3.91 versus 3.87, and LSTM configuration averages of 4.23/3.99/3.90 (v2 Tables 5, 8–9). These extend diagnostic results rather than demonstrate version-to-version performance gains.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, losses, conditioning equations, and staged optimization objectives are retained. Relocating the loss equation, clarifying optional inputs, correcting a token label, and explaining existing depth metrics introduce no substantive theoretical change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: spatial foundation priors, optional geometric inputs, action-head integration, and strong manipulation performance and robustness. New experiments support existing claims rather than redefine them.

C2.justification: V2 interprets the added experiments as supporting tolerance to test-time depth changes and limited sensitivity to the tested loss weights. Appendix E newly attributes stronger Kosmos-VLA performance and early optimization stability to longer histories. Existing fusion interpretations and future-work discussion remain.

D1.justification: Appendices A.2 and B newly disclose conditioning probability p=66% and loss weight lambda=0.01. The retained depth evaluation is explicitly described as zero-shot. Appendix B also removes OpenVLA-OFT's specific batch-size-128 statement while retaining the general 512 statement; this does not establish retraining.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations to pi0.5, Manipulation as in Simulation, Dense Policy, DSPv2, and DexGrasp-Diffusion. It also explicitly credits Visual Instruction Tuning as inspiration for staged training. The broader positioning against existing spatial VLAs remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Targeted reorganization introduces a main-text Training Objective subsection and brings existing ablation discussion into Section 4.3. V2 adds ethics, reproducibility, and LLM-usage statements, alongside local wording corrections. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds two sensitivity tables and two loss-curve figures, expands the modality table, and relocates the existing fusion/injection table and diagram together into the main text. Figure 1 is reformatted, and redundant fusion bar charts are removed while their tabulated results remain.

improvement.justification: The fixed-training depth tests and RGB-only control in v2 Table 5 provide more direct support for modality transferability. Appendix E and the disclosed conditioning probability and loss weight improve experimental scrutiny and reproducibility. These are useful, limited gains within the existing study; unchanged uncertainty reporting still limits interpretation of small performance differences.
